## Built with love for the Web

{% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} includes enriched built-in support for Node.js development with JavaScript and TypeScript, powered by the same underlying technologies that drive Visual Studio. {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} also includes great tooling for web technologies such as JSX/React, HTML, CSS, SCSS, Less, and JSON.
